instructions: This ledger is APPEND-ONLY. Never edit or delete an existing line. Every evaluation contact with a registered holdout dataset appends one entry_type=contact line via src/holdout.py (@holdout_access decorator or record_contact). Overrides are logged, never hidden. Backfilled entries reconstruct pre-ledger history from git log and docs and are marked backfilled_reconstructed=true; their timestamps are date-precision.

pitchgpt_2025_pitcher_disjoint.description: 2025 pitcher-disjoint cohort (pitchers absent from the 2015-2022 train split), including the fixed seed-42 10K-PA subsample every rollout evaluation reused. Audit F-C: ~13 substantive contacts already spent with no ledger; the 12 reconstructable ones are backfilled below.
pitchgpt_2025_pitcher_disjoint.budget_derivation: 12 recorded historical contacts + 1 pre-registered Phase 0.6.2 single evaluation run (PHASE_0.6.2_PLAN.md section 5: 'the only 2025 contact') + at most 1 attribution diagnostic comparison run permitted by the 0.6.2 kill criterion (section 6). Nothing else. Raising this budget requires a dated spec amendment referenced in a new ledger entry.
pitchgpt_2025_pitcher_disjoint.note: Day-to-day iteration belongs on 2023-fit / dev tiers, never here.

pitchgpt_2024.description: 2024 season. BURNED as a validation holdout: scripts/pitchgpt_ablation.py:87, scripts/pitchgpt_calibration_analysis.py:52, scripts/train_pitchgpt_v2_ump.py:65-67 all used TEST_RANGE=(2024,2024) during development (plan section 0 corrections). 2024 carries no validation authority; it is the dev tier. Dev-tier contacts are unbudgeted and need not be logged.

lockbox_2026_full_season.description: Full-season 2026 pitch-level data as an evaluation set. SEALED until the 2026 MLB regular season ends. After season end: hash-versioned, then ONE pre-registered contact per frozen spec version (plan 2.3/5.4, kill criterion K5). Resolving the 2026 contrarian boards against public end-of-season bWAR is NOT a lockbox contact (contrarian_2026_resolution_spec.md section 1.5).
lockbox_2026_full_season.seal_rule: sealed until an entry_type=unseal line is appended after the final 2026 regular-season game; src/holdout.py refuses pre-unseal contacts

ladder_rule: OPTIONAL for the budgeted tier (Blum & Hardt 2015 'Ladder'): a metric measured on pitchgpt_2025_pitcher_disjoint is only RECORDED as an improvement if it beats the prior best by a preset epsilon declared before the run; otherwise the prior best stands and the contact still counts against budget. Adopted as guidance, not yet load-bearing for any gate.
